inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Bright storybook fantasy strategy game look in the spirit of Kingdom Rush: cheerful saturated colours, bold clean readable shapes, chunky pixel clusters, soft cartoon shading, sunny daylight under a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, spooky but cheerful.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright storybook fantasy strategy game stage, cheerful, saturated, bold readable shapes", "lighting": "Sunny midday light from the upper left as discrete flat pixel colour planes, soft cartoon shadows, the grass arena evenly lit and calm.", "color_palette": ["#2c5a30", "#4f9a3e", "#7ab84e", "#a8d46a", "#e8cc96", "#b48a62", "#6e5240", "#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#ffffff", "#3a2834"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade fighting game stage, no figures, no text. The top third is sky above a distant ridge, seen through a gap right of centre. The back of the stage is a row of ruins framed by a tall piece at each edge, the crypt left of centre and a huge tree on the right. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor where two armies will stand, calm and even, clearly separated from the back. The bottom corners hold dark foreground framing pieces in shadow.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 400, 120], "desc": "a tall broken warm sandstone pillar wrapped in ivy"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [80, 190, 410, 470], "desc": "a cheerful little ruined crypt temple of warm sandstone with a round dark doorway and two lit torches"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [260, 465, 400, 650], "desc": "low broken sandstone walls with flowers"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [150, 470, 330, 760], "desc": "a distant soft green ridge with a small stepped pyramid court"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 640, 410, 920], "desc": "a huge round leafy green oak tree"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [30, 910, 400, 1000], "desc": "a mossy sandstone arch"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [400, 70, 980, 930], "desc": "a sunny green meadow arena with a few pale flagstones, calm and even"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [820, 0, 1000, 200], "desc": "bright green bushes and flowers"}]}}
